_comment: Partner employers: companies that gave UApply their openings AND agreed to receive applications by email. Copy this file to uapply-partners.json (git-ignored) and put real employers there. An employer with no recorded consent is ignored. An employer with no contact address is link-out only. Never add a company that has not agreed. The entries below are placeholders.

employers.name: Example Partner Co
employers.consent: Placeholder only: replace with how and when this employer agreed, for example 'signed partner agreement 2026-10-12'

jobs.blurb: A placeholder listing that shows the format. It is not a real opening.
